movie_title: How The Immune System ACTUALLY Works – IMMUNE
introduction: To preorder IMMUNE click here: https://kgs.link/ImmuneBook –– It’s available in English and German a
lead_intro: The human immune system is a marvel of biological complexity, tirelessly protecting us from threats every day. Dive into the fascinating world of our immune system and its epic battles within our bodies!

quiz.question: What is the role of macrophages in the immune system?
choices: B. They fight and devour bacteria
C. They activate helper T cells
quiz.answer: B. They fight and devour bacteria
quiz.explanation: Macrophages are large cells in the immune system that engulf and digest bacteria to defend the body against infections.

quiz.question: What is the function of neutrophils in the immune response?
choices: B. They release chemical alarm signals
C. They are suicide warriors that kill bacteria
quiz.answer: C. They are suicide warriors that kill bacteria
quiz.explanation: Neutrophils are intense suicide warriors that actively kill bacteria by releasing deadly chemicals and even exploding to trap and eliminate the invaders.

quiz.question: What do helper T cells do in the immune system?
quiz.explanation: Helper T cells play a crucial role in activating and coordinating other immune cells like macrophages and B cells to mount an effective defense against pathogens.

quiz.question: What are B cells responsible for in the immune response?
quiz.explanation: B cells are responsible for producing antibodies, which are protein super weapons that specifically target and neutralize pathogens in the body.

quiz.question: What is the significance of memory cells in the immune system?
choices: B. They help regulate body temperature
quiz.explanation: Memory cells are immune cells that remember past infections and provide long-lasting immunity, ensuring a rapid and effective response if the same pathogen reappears in the future.
